title: Capability Gaps
description: Ranked list of missing or partially-matched capabilities. Each gap includes a structural energy score and a suggest_action for the limb-designer.

gaps.description: Ranked gaps, lowest energy first (most urgent).

desired.description: The desired capability that was checked.

status.description: Whether the capability exists, is missing, or is partially matched.

energy.description: Structural energy: 0 = fully satisfied, higher = more urgent gap. Absent capabilities score highest.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation of the gap and suggested fix.

matching_candidates.description: Existing items that partially match (for partial status).
